scripts.dev: export NODE_ENV=development && pnpm run build && pnpm run start
scripts.test:security: sh -c 'mkdir -p .test-dist; pnpm exec esbuild src/lib/password-reset-store.test.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=.test-dist/password-reset-store.test.cjs; status=$?; if [ $status -eq 0 ]; then node --test .test-dist/password-reset-store.test.cjs; status=$?; fi; rm -rf .test-dist; exit $status'
